baseline_policy: Reuse all 18 saved ASv6.9 outputs without rerunning or editing them.
checks: Whether sports, Katie and AI outputs add model commentary about unclear, unstated or implausible source meaning.
Whether any output introduces a newly calculated numerical result, including the Iran time gap.
Whether source-expressed uncertainty, negation and arguments survive, including the Kremlin nothing-to-add statement and Iran's normal-conditions contrast and future-adoption question.
Inspect all generated subjects against their full source notes; report additional issues separately from the targeted checks.
interpretation_rules: Supported alternative interpretations and reasonable implications are permitted.
Broad, overlapping, nested and duplicate subjects are permitted.
LLC and smile/teeth interpretations remain open judgments, not established failures.
Uncertainty words are not automatically errors; distinguish the subject's possible meaning from added commentary about interpreting it.
unchanged: Frozen ASv6.8, tested ASv6.9, full notes and ordering, normalization, response schema, runner, isolation and all prior outputs.
limitations: Six previously used development notes, not an unseen holdout.
Three calls per note do not establish corpus reliability.
ASv6.9 is a saved baseline, not a concurrent rerun.
Two prompt changes are tested together; this does not isolate their individual effects.

runtime.cap_scope: The pinned Codex executable launches its own codex.slice scope; outer launcher limits and measurements do not cover that separate scope.
runtime.host_checks: Inspect available memory and OS memory/I/O pressure between trials. Pause if resource pressure develops.
runtime.budget_ledger: Existing subscription only; no new paid commitment.
